title: My Profile
sub: Your data is saved in your account, with a copy on this device.
name: Your name or nickname
addressNote: This changes the Arabic wording. English isn't affected.
missionLengthNote: Short uses the easier version of challenges.
languageNote: Switching doesn't change your progress or mission. Saved messages stay as they are.
motionNote: Stops unnecessary movement. It also applies if your device's setting is on.
soundNote: Nothing relies on sound to be understood.
nextPrayerNote: You enter it yourself, for today only.
protect: Protected time after the call to prayer
drivingNote: Don't open the app while driving. Set this before you leave. The app can't tell if you're driving by itself, and it doesn't use your location.
drivingNowNote: Stops all challenges and chat typing until you turn it off.
driveHoursNote: Optional. If you've driven a lot, I'll suggest a break after you arrive.
driveBreak: You told me you've driven {{n}} hours today. Once you've arrived safely, take a break.
notConnected: Calendar, traffic and weather aren't connected. What you approve in chat appears below.
aiNote: When on, your message, recent chat messages and a results summary go to OpenAI to produce a reply. We don't send your name, your journeys, what you type in challenges or your "How Are You Feeling?" answers. Under OpenAI's policy, API data isn't used for training and may be kept for up to 30 days to monitor abuse.
storedEnergy: {{n}} energy check-ins and {{m}} messages you wrote in chat
approved: What you've approved about your day
wipeQ: Delete all your data from this device?
wipeText: Your points, attempts and messages will all be deleted, and we can't restore them. We don't keep another copy.
typedText: Your tasks, steps and notes in challenges will be deleted. Your points and results stay.
cityNote: Choose your city to protect every prayer automatically, or enter the time yourself.
flashCity: City saved. Prayer times are calculated each day.
flashManual: Back to entering the time yourself.
flashTypedFailed: Deleted from this device, but we couldn’t delete it from your account. Please try again.
